## Details

<a id="storage_screen_script"></a>
### [`storage_screen_script`](../../../../src/script/storage_screen.asm#L6) `$236A-$23BD`

*data*

Script: draws the storage screen: character $81 on all of $5c00, colour 12, the title 'Picture List For', the command texts (Save, Get, Name & Save, Change Disk, Init Disk) and the 16 slots PIC A-P. It continues after $23ff to $2437.
